name: Essentials
description: Baseline protections for control files, credentials, destructive actions, and egress.

rules.title: Protect agent and Guardrails control files
rules.description: Stop agent-initiated writes to agent hooks, MCP configs, and security configuration files.
rules.reason_template: Agents cannot modify agent hook settings or Guardrails control files.

rules.title: Prevent hook disabling and security bypass flags
rules.description: Block commands that disable hooks, remove verification checks, or bypass sandboxing.
rules.reason_template: Bypassing security hooks or permission boundaries is blocked by Essentials.

rules.title: Guard credential stores and private keys
rules.description: Require approval before an agent reads SSH keys, cloud credentials, or token caches.
rules.reason_template: Reading private keys or credential stores requires an explicit approval grant.

rules.title: Review destructive shell commands
rules.description: Require approval for recursive force deletes, disk wipes, and destructive resets.
rules.reason_template: Recursive or irreversible deletion requires human approval.

rules.title: Gate privilege elevation attempts
rules.description: Ask before running sudo, doas, or elevated admin shells from an agent session.
rules.reason_template: Privilege elevation from an agent session requires approval.

rules.title: Observe outbound paste and webhook transfers
rules.description: Observe external uploads via curl/Invoke-RestMethod before promoting to Ask or Block.
rules.reason_template: Unreviewed outbound upload pattern matched telemetry Watch rule.

rules.title: Monitor write-capable MCP tool invocations
rules.description: Track external MCP state-mutating calls while baselines build.
rules.reason_template: State-changing MCP tool invocation matched Watch monitoring rule.
